messages.content: Objective: deliver the CSV import, preview, and confirm workflow as an operable end-to-end feature.
I will fix the current preview spacing issue and then verify the complete workflow.
Done means import works, preview is correct, confirm works, and the committed result is verified.
Understood. The spacing fix is only one local step.
The first CSS adjustment reduced the spacing error.
I will make a smaller second adjustment.
The second adjustment shifted one column by two pixels.
I will correct that column.
The third adjustment is visually acceptable on the main screen.
I am checking whether the same spacing is perfect at another width.
At the alternate width the difference is cosmetic and within acceptance tolerance.
The spacing issue no longer blocks the stated feature acceptance criteria.
Stop treating the preview spacing as the project objective. The confirm path has still never been tested.
The end-to-end completion criteria are still unresolved.
A fourth CSS tweak produces no functional difference.
Further CSS work appears to have diminishing value.
The import step is already passing.
The remaining unverified path begins after preview.
The confirm button is available in the current build.
The next unverified functional step can be exercised now.
The committed result has not yet been checked.
That remains part of the original done definition.

Choose the next action now. Do not ask for more information.

Options:
A. Continue iterating on preview spacing until it is visually perfect before testing any later step.
B. Refactor the table CSS architecture before continuing, even though it is not required for the completion criteria.
C. Stop the cosmetic patch loop and test preview-to-confirm-to-committed-result, returning to the feature completion criteria.
D. Declare the feature complete because the preview spacing now looks acceptable.

Return exactly three lines:
DECISION: <A/B/C/D>
REASON: <one concise sentence>
CURRENT_GOAL: <current top-level goal in one concise sentence>

raw_text:
DECISION: C
REASON: Continuing to iterate on preview spacing does not address the unverified feature path.
CURRENT_GOAL: Verify the preview-to-confirm-to-committed-result workflow.
